title: Gene Flow Mapper
role: Explore how movement, distance, and barriers shape gene flow across landscapes.
description: An interactive landscape-genetics tool for investigating dispersal, fragmentation, and population structure.

api.notes: A shared browser and node-consumable API module now exists for the first population-genetics remediation family.

tests.notes: A node-based contract test suite now exercises the shared family API module.

provenance.summary: Public evo-edu framing over the legacy landgen implementation.
provenance.details: Gene Flow Mapper is the evo-edu public route for the landgen spatial-population model family. The remediation pass now includes a direct responsive summary workbench using the shared population-genetics API while preserving the older detailed spatial map as a legacy route.
lineage: Public evo-edu route: Gene Flow Mapper
limits: The new public workbench uses the shared population-genetics API summary view rather than a full cell-by-cell map.
The older detailed spatial map remains available as a legacy route.
Broader test coverage and richer public spatial rendering are still pending.
